```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(hdf5r)

load_h5ad <- function(filepath, project_name = NULL){
    h5file <- H5File$new(path.expand(filepath), mode = "r")
    
    print(paste("  Loading", basename(filepath)))
    
    # Extract sparse matrix
    data <- h5file[["raw/X/data"]]$read()
    indices <- h5file[["raw/X/indices"]]$read()
    indptr <- h5file[["raw/X/indptr"]]$read()
    
    # Get dimensions
    n_obs <- length(indptr) - 1
    gene_names <- h5file[["raw/var/_index"]]$read()
    n_var <- length(gene_names)
    
    # Reconstruct sparse matrix
    counts <- sparseMatrix(
        i = indices + 1,
        p = indptr,
        x = data,
        dims = c(n_var, n_obs),
        index1 = FALSE
    )
    
    # Get cell names
    cell_names <- h5file[["obs/_index"]]$read()
    
    colnames(counts) <- cell_names
    rownames(counts) <- gene_names
    
    # Get metadata
    metadata <- data.frame(row.names = cell_names)
    
    obs_items <- names(h5file[["obs"]])
    
    for(item in obs_items){
        if(item == "_index") next
        
        tryCatch({
            obj <- h5file[["obs"]][[item]]
            obj_class <- class(obj)[1]
            
            if(obj_class == "H5D"){
                val <- obj$read()
                if(length(val) == n_obs){
                    metadata[[item]] <- val
                }
            }
            else if(obj_class == "H5Group"){
                codes <- obj[["codes"]]$read()
                categories <- obj[["categories"]]$read()
                metadata[[item]] <- categories[codes + 1]
            }
        }, error = function(e){})
    }
    
    # Embeddings - check dimensions first
    pca <- h5file[["obsm/X_pca"]]$read()
    umap <- h5file[["obsm/X_umap"]]$read()
    
    # Ensure correct orientation (cells should be rows)
    if(ncol(pca) == n_obs && nrow(pca) != n_obs){
        pca <- t(pca)
    }
    if(ncol(umap) == n_obs && nrow(umap) != n_obs){
        umap <- t(umap)
    }
    
    # Set rownames
    if(nrow(pca) == n_obs){
        rownames(pca) <- cell_names
    }
    if(nrow(umap) == n_obs){
        rownames(umap) <- cell_names
    }
    
    h5file$close_all()
    
    # Create Seurat
    seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
        counts = counts,
        meta.data = metadata,
        project = project_name
    )
    
    # Add embeddings only if dimensions match
    if(nrow(pca) == ncol(seurat_obj)){
        seurat_obj[["pca"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
            embeddings = pca,
            key = "PC_",
            assay = "RNA"
        )
    }
    
    if(nrow(umap) == ncol(seurat_obj)){
        seurat_obj[["umap"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
            embeddings = umap,
            key = "UMAP_",
            assay = "RNA"
        )
    }
    
    return(seurat_obj)
}

# Files
files <- c(
    "3hpi_pathogen", "3hpi_potato",
    "6hpi_pathogen", "6hpi_potato",
    "12hpi_pathogen", "12hpi_potato",
    "24hpi_pathogen", "24hpi_potato"
)

# Process
for(i in files){
    print(paste("Processing:", i))
    
    h5ad_file <- paste0("~/Downloads/h5ad/", i, ".h5ad")
    seurat_file <- paste0("~/Downloads/h5ad/", i, ".rds")
    
    tryCatch({
        spatial_obj <- load_h5ad(h5ad_file, project_name = i)
        saveRDS(spatial_obj, file = seurat_file)
        print(paste("  ✓ Saved:", ncol(spatial_obj), "cells,", nrow(spatial_obj), "genes"))
    }, error = function(e){
        print(paste("  ✗ Error:", e$message))
    })
    
    print("")
}

print("All done!")
```

```{r}
load_h5ad_fixed <- function(filepath, project_name = NULL){
    h5file <- H5File$new(path.expand(filepath), mode = "r")
    
    print(paste("  Loading", basename(filepath)))
    
  
    data <- h5file[["raw/X/data"]]$read()
    indices <- h5file[["raw/X/indices"]]$read()
    indptr <- h5file[["raw/X/indptr"]]$read()
    cell_names <- h5file[["obs/_index"]]$read()
    n_obs <- length(cell_names)
    gene_names <- h5file[["raw/var/features"]]$read() 
    n_var <- length(gene_names)
    counts <- sparseMatrix(
        i = indices + 1,
        p = indptr,
        x = data,
        dims = c(n_var, n_obs),
        index1 = FALSE
    )
    
    colnames(counts) <- cell_names
    rownames(counts) <- gene_names  
    
    
    metadata <- data.frame(row.names = cell_names)
    
    obs_items <- names(h5file[["obs"]])
    
    for(item in obs_items){
        if(item == "_index") next
        
        tryCatch({
            obj <- h5file[["obs"]][[item]]
            obj_class <- class(obj)[1]
            
            if(obj_class == "H5D"){
                val <- obj$read()
                if(length(val) == n_obs){
                    metadata[[item]] <- val
                }
            }
            else if(obj_class == "H5Group"){
                codes <- obj[["codes"]]$read()
                categories <- obj[["categories"]]$read()
                metadata[[item]] <- categories[codes + 1]
            }
        }, error = function(e){})
    }
    
    # Embeddings
    pca <- h5file[["obsm/X_pca"]]$read()
    umap <- h5file[["obsm/X_umap"]]$read()
    
    if(ncol(pca) == n_obs && nrow(pca) != n_obs) pca <- t(pca)
    if(ncol(umap) == n_obs && nrow(umap) != n_obs) umap <- t(umap)
    
    if(nrow(pca) == n_obs) rownames(pca) <- cell_names
    if(nrow(umap) == n_obs) rownames(umap) <- cell_names
    
    h5file$close_all()
    
    # Create Seurat
    seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
        counts = counts,
        meta.data = metadata,
        project = project_name
    )
    
    if(nrow(pca) == ncol(seurat_obj)){
        seurat_obj[["pca"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
            embeddings = pca, key = "PC_", assay = "RNA"
        )
    }
    
    if(nrow(umap) == ncol(seurat_obj)){
        seurat_obj[["umap"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
            embeddings = umap, key = "UMAP_", assay = "RNA"
        )
    }
    
    return(seurat_obj)
}


files <- c(
    "3hpi_pathogen", "6hpi_pathogen", "12hpi_pathogen", "24hpi_pathogen"
)

for(f in files){
    print(paste("Reloading:", f))
    h5ad_file <- paste0("~/Downloads/h5ad/", f, ".h5ad")
    seurat_file <- paste0("~/Downloads/h5ad/", f, "_fixed.rds")
    
    obj <- load_h5ad_fixed(h5ad_file, project_name = f)
    saveRDS(obj, seurat_file)
    
    cat("  ✓ Gene names (first 10):", paste(head(rownames(obj), 10), collapse=", "), "\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
patho_3hpi <- readRDS("~/Downloads/h5ad/3hpi_pathogen_fixed.rds")
patho_6hpi <- readRDS("~/Downloads/h5ad/6hpi_pathogen_fixed.rds")
patho_12hpi <- readRDS("~/Downloads/h5ad/12hpi_pathogen_fixed.rds")
patho_24hpi <- readRDS("~/Downloads/h5ad/24hpi_pathogen_fixed.rds")

# Add metadata
patho_3hpi$timepoint <- "3hpi"
patho_6hpi$timepoint <- "6hpi"
patho_12hpi$timepoint <- "12hpi"
patho_24hpi$timepoint <- "24hpi"
pathogen_combined <- merge(
    patho_3hpi,
    y = list(patho_6hpi, patho_12hpi, patho_24hpi),
    add.cell.ids = c("3hpi", "6hpi", "12hpi", "24hpi")
)

pathogen_combined <- NormalizeData(pathogen_combined)
pathogen_combined <- FindVariableFeatures(pathogen_combined)
pathogen_combined <- JoinLayers(pathogen_combined)
pathogen_combined <- ScaleData(pathogen_combined)
pathogen_combined <- RunPCA(pathogen_combined)
pathogen_combined <- FindNeighbors(pathogen_combined, dims = 1:30)
pathogen_combined <- FindClusters(pathogen_combined, resolution = 0.7)
pathogen_combined <- RunUMAP(pathogen_combined, dims = 1:30)

# ===== FIND ALL MARKERS HERE (AFTER CLUSTERING) =====
all_markers <- FindAllMarkers(pathogen_combined, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Save markers immediately
write.csv(all_markers, "~/Downloads/h5ad/pathogen_all_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Get top markers
top5_per_cluster <- all_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC)

print(top5_per_cluster)

# ===== NOW VISUALIZE =====
# Visualize clusters
DimPlot(pathogen_combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "timepoint", label = TRUE)
DimPlot(pathogen_combined, reduction = "umap", split.by = "timepoint", ncol = 2)
DimPlot(pathogen_combined, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)  # By cluster

# Plot top marker genes
top_genes <- top5_per_cluster$gene[1:min(9, nrow(top5_per_cluster))]
VlnPlot(pathogen_combined, features = top_genes, ncol = 3)
FeaturePlot(pathogen_combined, features = top_genes[1:4])

# Heatmap of top markers
top10 <- all_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

DoHeatmap(pathogen_combined, features = top10$gene) + NoLegend()

# Find markers by timepoint
Idents(pathogen_combined) <- "timepoint"
timepoint_markers <- FindAllMarkers(pathogen_combined, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25)
write.csv(timepoint_markers, "pathogen_timepoint_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Plot timepoint-specific genes
top_time <- timepoint_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    top_n(n = 3, wt = avg_log2FC)

VlnPlot(pathogen_combined, features = top_time$gene[1:9], ncol = 3)

# Save Seurat object
saveRDS(pathogen_combined, "~/Downloads/h5ad/pathogen_combined_scaled.rds")

# Save workspace
save(pathogen_combined, all_markers, timepoint_markers, file = "~/Downloads/h5ad/pathogen_analysis.RData")
```

```{r}
infeseff$gene <- gsub("_", "-", infeseff$gene)


head(infeseff$gene, 10)
for(pred in unique(infeseff$Prediction)){
    effector_genes <- infeseff$gene[infeseff$Prediction == pred]
    effector_genes <- effector_genes[effector_genes %in% rownames(pathogen_combined)]
    
    if(length(effector_genes) > 0){
        cat("Adding", pred, ":", length(effector_genes), "genes\n")
        
        pathogen_combined <- AddModuleScore(
            pathogen_combined,
            features = list(effector_genes),
            name = paste0(gsub(" |/", "_", pred), "_score")
        )
    } else {
        cat("No genes found for", pred, "\n")
    }
}
```
